title: Rutaecarpine Attenuates Monosodium Urate Crystal-Induced Gouty Inflammation via Inhibition of TNFR-MAPK/NF-kappaB and NLRP3 Inflammasome Signaling Pathways.
authors: Li, Min; Yin, Zhu-Jun; Li, Li; Quan, Yun-Yun; Wang, Ting; Zhu, Xin; Tan, Rui-Rong; Zeng, Jin; Hua, Hua; Wu, Qin-Xuan; Zhao, Jun-Ning
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然产物RUT对痛风炎症的抑制作用，涉及TNF-alpha分子对接，但核心是炎症信号通路与药物抗炎机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To investigate the anti-inflammatory effect of rutaecarpine (RUT) on monosodium urate crystal (MSU)-induced murine peritonitis in mice and further explored the underlying mechanism of RUT in lipopolysaccharide (LPS)/MSU-induced gout model in vitro. METHODS: In MSU-induced mice, 36 male C57BL/6 mice were randomly divided into 6 groups of 8 mice each group, including the control group, model group, RUT low-, medium-, and high-doses groups, and prednisone acetate group. The mice in each group were orally administered the corresponding drugs or vehicle once a day for 7 consecutive days. The gout inflammation model was established by intraperitoneal injection of MSU to evaluate the anti-gout inflammatory effects of RUT. Then the proinflammatory cytokines were measured by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA) and the proportions of infiltrating neutrophils cytokines were detected by flow cytometry. In LPS/MSU-treated or untreated THP-1 macrophages, cell viability was observed by cell counting kit 8 and proinflammatory cytokines were measured by ELISA. The percentage of pyroptotic cells were detected by flow cytometry. Respectively, the mRNA and protein levels were measured by real-time quantitative polymerase chain reaction (qRT-PCR) and Western blot, the nuclear translocation of nuclear factor kappaB (NF-kappaB) p65 was observed by laser confocal imaging. Additionally, surface plasmon resonance (SPR) and molecular docking were applied to validate the binding ability of RUT components to tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-alpha) targets. RESULTS: RUT reduced the levels of infiltrating neutrophils and monocytes and decreased the levels of the proinflammatory cytokines interleukin 1beta (IL-1beta) and interleukin 6 (IL-6, all P<0.01). In vitro, RUT reduced the production of IL-1beta, IL-6 and TNF-alpha. In addition, RT-PCR revealed the inhibitory effects of RUT on the mRNA levels of IL-1beta, IL-6, cyclooxygenase-2 and TNF-alpha (P<0.05 or P<0.01). Mechanistically, RUT markedly reduced protein expressions of tumor necrosis factor receptor (TNFR), phospho-mitogen-activated protein kinase (p-MAPK), phospho-extracellular signal-regulated kinase, phospho-c-Jun N-terminal kinase, phospho-NF-kappaB, phospho-kinase alpha/beta, NOD-like receptor thermal protein domain associated protein 3 (NLRPS), cleaved-cysteinyl aspartate specific proteinase-1 and cleaved-gasdermin D in macrophages (P<0.05 or P<0.01). Molecularly, SPR revealed that RUT bound to TNF-alpha with a calculated equilibrium dissociation constant of 31.7 micromol/L. Molecular docking further confirmed that RUT could interact directly with the TNF-alpha protein via hydrogen bonding, van der Waals interactions, and carbon-hydrogen bonding. CONCLUSION: RUT alleviated MSU-induced peritonitis and inhibited the TNFR1-MAPK/NF-kappaB and NLRP3 inflammasome signaling pathway to attenuate gouty inflammation induced by LPS/MSU in THP-1 macrophages, suggesting that RUT could be a potential therapeutic candidate for gout.
abstract_zh: 目的：探讨吴茱萸碱（rutaecarpine, RUT）对尿酸钠晶体（monosodium urate crystal, MSU）诱导的小鼠腹膜炎的抗炎作用，并进一步探索RUT在脂多糖（lipopolysaccharide, LPS）/MSU诱导的体外痛风模型中的作用机制。方法：在MSU诱导的小鼠中，将36只雄性C57BL/6小鼠随机分为6组，每组8只，包括对照组、模型组、RUT低、中、高剂量组和醋酸泼尼松组。各组小鼠每天口服相应药物或溶媒一次，连续7天。通过腹腔注射MSU建立痛风炎症模型，以评估RUT的抗痛风炎症作用。随后，采用酶联免疫吸附试验（enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay, ELISA）检测促炎细胞因子，并通过流式细胞术检测浸润中性粒细胞的比例。在LPS/MSU处理或未处理的THP-1巨噬细胞中，通过细胞计数试剂盒8观察细胞活力，并通过ELISA检测促炎细胞因子。通过流式细胞术检测焦亡细胞百分比。分别通过实时定量聚合酶链反应（real-time quantitative polymerase chain reaction, qRT-PCR）和Western blot检测mRNA和蛋白水平，通过激光共聚焦成像观察核因子κB（nuclear factor kappaB, NF-κB）p65的核转位。此外，采用表面等离子体共振（surface plasmon resonance, SPR）和分子对接验证RUT成分与肿瘤坏死因子α（tumor necrosis factor alpha, TNF-α）靶点的结合能力。结果：RUT降低了浸润中性粒细胞和单核细胞的水平，并降低了促炎细胞因子白细胞介素1β（interleukin 1beta, IL-1β）和白细胞介素6（interleukin 6, IL-6）的水平（均P<0.01）。在体外，RUT减少了IL-1β、IL-6和TNF-α的产生。此外，RT-PCR显示RUT对IL-1β、IL-6、环氧合酶-2和TNF-α的mRNA水平具有抑制作用（P<0.05或P<0.01）。在机制上，RUT显著降低了巨噬细胞中肿瘤坏死因子受体（tumor necrosis factor receptor, TNFR）、磷酸化丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（phospho-mitogen-activated protein kinase, p-MAPK）、磷酸化细胞外信号调节激酶、磷酸化c-Jun N末端激酶、磷酸化NF-κB、磷酸化激酶α/β、NOD样受体热蛋白结构域相关蛋白3（NOD-like receptor thermal protein domain associated protein 3, NLRP3）、裂解型半胱氨酸天冬氨酸特异性蛋白酶-1和裂解型gasdermin D的蛋白表达（P<0.05或P<0.01）。在分子水平上，SPR显示RUT与TNF-α结合，计算所得平衡解离常数为31.7微摩尔/升。分子对接进一步证实，RUT可通过氢键、范德华力和碳氢键直接与TNF-α蛋白相互作用。结论：RUT减轻了MSU诱导的腹膜炎，并通过抑制TNFR1-MAPK/NF-κB和NLRP3炎症小体信号通路，减轻LPS/MSU诱导的THP-1巨噬细胞中的痛风炎症，提示RUT可能成为痛风的潜在治疗候选药物。
